sentences.text:
The Court made the following Order:
The learned counsel for the petitioners submits that the petitioners are arraigned as Accused Nos. 1 to 4 in Crime No. 24 of 2025 on the file of the SVU Campus Police Station, Tirupati.
2. It is alleged that the petitioners have committed offences under Sections 420, 474, 471, and 468 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The 2nd respondent has filed a private complaint and got it referred to the police for investigation.

It is submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the petitioners have repaid the amount to the 2 nd respondent and, unmindful of the same, the 2nd respondent has filed a private complaint and got it referred to the police for investigation.
The police have registered the crime.

It is also submitted that the petitioners have secured anticipatory bail and pray for the quashing of the F.I.R.
4.
The learned Assistant Public Prosecutor submits that the case is still at the investigation stage.
